name: Sheet-Pan Garlic Chicken Thighs & Broccoli
description: One pan, almost no cleanup. Crispy-skinned thighs roasted over broccoli.
keto_swap: Naturally keto. Family can add microwave rice or roasted potatoes on the side.
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Toss thighs with 2 tbsp oil, paprika, minced garlic, salt and pepper.
Cut broccoli into florets and toss with remaining oil and salt on a large sheet pan.
Nestle thighs skin-side up on top of the broccoli.
Roast 30 to 35 minutes until chicken hits 175F and skin is crisp.
Squeeze lemon over everything and serve.

name: Taco Night
description: Seasoned ground beef with all the toppings. Everybody builds their own.
keto_swap: Keto: serve in a bowl over shredded lettuce or in lettuce cups, skip beans and tortillas. Family: tortillas or hard shells.
steps: Brown the beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up, about 8 minutes.
Drain extra fat, add taco seasoning and 2/3 cup water, simmer 5 minutes.
Chop lettuce and tomatoes, slice avocado, set out cheese and sour cream.
Everyone builds their own: shells for the family, lettuce bowl for keto.

name: Smash Burgers
description: Thin, crispy-edged burgers cooked in a hot skillet in minutes.
keto_swap: Keto: wrap in lettuce, skip the bun and ketchup (use mustard, pickles, mayo). Family: regular buns.
steps: Roll beef into 10 balls. Heat a cast-iron or heavy skillet on high.
Smash each ball flat with a spatula, season with salt and pepper.
Cook 2 minutes, flip, top with cheese, cook 1 more minute.
Serve on buns for the family, in lettuce wraps for keto.

name: Sausage & Peppers Sheet Pan
description: Smoked sausage with peppers and onions. Fast and hard to mess up.
keto_swap: Keto: sausage and veggies only. Family: add baby potatoes to the pan or serve on hoagie rolls.
steps: Heat oven to 425F. Slice sausage, peppers and onion.
Toss on a sheet pan with oil and Italian seasoning (potatoes go on a second pan or the same pan, cut small).
Roast 25 minutes, stirring once, until browned at the edges.

name: Lemon Butter Salmon with Asparagus
description: Restaurant-style dinner in 20 minutes.
keto_swap: Naturally keto. Family can add rice or couscous.
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Put salmon and trimmed asparagus on a lined sheet pan.
Melt butter with minced garlic and juice of 1 lemon, spoon over everything.
Season with salt and pepper, top salmon with lemon slices.
Bake 12 to 15 minutes until salmon flakes easily.

name: Chicken Fajita Skillet
description: Sizzling chicken, peppers and onions. Tortillas on the side for those who want them.
keto_swap: Keto: eat it as a bowl with cheese, sour cream and guac. Family: warm tortillas and rice.
steps: Slice chicken, peppers and onion into strips. Toss chicken with seasoning.
Sear chicken in oil over high heat, 6 to 7 minutes, until cooked through. Remove.
Cook peppers and onion 5 minutes until charred and soft.
Return chicken, toss together, and serve with cheese and tortillas.

name: Spaghetti & Meat Sauce
description: Classic Sunday dinner. Big batch, great leftovers.
keto_swap: Keto: serve the sauce over zucchini noodles or spaghetti squash. Family: regular spaghetti.
steps: Brown beef with diced onion and garlic, 8 to 10 minutes. Drain.
Add marinara, simmer 20 minutes.
Boil spaghetti for the family. Spiralize zucchini and saute 2 to 3 minutes for keto.
Top with parmesan.

name: Slow Cooker Pulled Pork
description: Set it in the morning, shred it at dinner. Makes plenty for leftovers.
keto_swap: Keto: sugar-free BBQ sauce, serve with slaw or green beans. Family: buns and regular BBQ sauce.

ingredients.name: BBQ rub or brown sugar-free rub

steps: Rub the pork all over and set in the slow cooker with the broth.
Cook on low 8 to 10 hours until it shreds easily.
Shred with two forks, toss in some of the cooking liquid and BBQ sauce.
Serve on buns with slaw, or just slaw for keto.

name: Beef & Broccoli Stir Fry
description: Takeout-style flank steak and broccoli at home.
keto_swap: Keto: use coconut aminos or low-sugar soy and serve over cauliflower rice. Family: white rice.
steps: Slice steak thin against the grain. Mix soy, garlic, ginger and sesame oil as the sauce.
Sear beef in a very hot pan in two batches, about 2 minutes each. Set aside.
Stir-fry broccoli with a splash of water, 4 minutes.
Return beef, pour in sauce, toss 1 minute. Serve over rice or cauliflower rice.

name: Egg Roll in a Bowl
description: All the egg roll flavor, no wrapper. 20 minutes.
keto_swap: Keto as written. Family can eat it over rice or with store-bought egg rolls on the side.
steps: Brown the meat with garlic and ginger in a large skillet, 7 minutes.
Add coleslaw mix and soy sauce, stir and cook until wilted, 6 to 8 minutes.
Finish with sesame oil and sliced green onions.

name: Chicken Alfredo Bake
description: Creamy and cheesy, a crowd pleaser.
keto_swap: Keto: bake the chicken and sauce over broccoli instead of pasta in a separate dish. Family: penne.
steps: Cook and cube the chicken (bake or pan sear). Boil penne for the family.
Mix chicken, sauce and pasta in a baking dish for the family. Put chicken, sauce and steamed broccoli in a small dish for keto.
Top both with mozzarella.
Bake at 375F for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbly.

name: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
description: Pan-seared chicken in a garlic, sun-dried tomato and spinach cream sauce.
keto_swap: Naturally keto. Family can serve it over pasta or with bread.
steps: Slice chicken breasts in half horizontally, season, and sear 5 minutes per side. Remove.
Saute garlic in the same pan, add broth, cream and parmesan, simmer 3 minutes.
Add sun-dried tomatoes and spinach until wilted.
Return chicken to the pan and spoon sauce over it.

name: Baked Meatballs & Marinara
description: Easy oven meatballs. Make extra and freeze half.
keto_swap: Keto: use almond flour or crushed pork rinds in the meatballs, serve over zoodles. Family: regular breadcrumbs and pasta.
steps: Heat oven to 400F. Mix meats, eggs, parmesan, almond flour, salt, pepper and Italian seasoning.
Roll into 20 balls and bake on a lined sheet 18 to 20 minutes.
Warm marinara, add meatballs.
Serve over spaghetti for the family and zoodles for keto.

name: Cheesy Chicken Quesadillas
description: Fast, kid-approved, uses rotisserie chicken.
steps: Shred the chicken.
Fill half of each tortilla with cheese and chicken, fold over.
Cook in a dry skillet 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and melty.
Slice and serve with salsa and sour cream.

name: One-Pot Chicken & Rice
description: Everything cooks in one pot. Great for travel weeks.
steps: Season chicken and brown in a Dutch oven or deep skillet, 3 minutes per side. Remove.
Cook diced onion 3 minutes, stir in rice, then add broth and garlic powder.
Nestle chicken on top, cover, and simmer on low 20 minutes.
Stir in veggies, cover 5 more minutes, then fluff.

name: Easy Baked Ziti
description: No-fuss pasta bake that feeds everybody twice.
steps: Boil pasta 2 minutes shy of package time. Brown the meat.
Mix pasta, meat, sauce and half the mozzarella. Spread into a 9x13 dish.
Dollop ricotta on top, then add the rest of the mozzarella.
Bake at 375F for 25 minutes, covered first 15, uncovered the rest.

name: Sloppy Joes
description: Kid classic. 20 minutes, one pan.
steps: Brown beef and diced onion, drain.
Stir in ketchup, mustard, brown sugar, salt and pepper. Simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon onto toasted buns.

name: Hearty Beef Chili
description: Thick, meaty, and good for leftovers. Beans are optional.
keto_swap: Keto: leave out the beans and top with cheese and sour cream. Family: stir in a can of kidney beans and add Fritos or cornbread.
steps: Brown beef and onion in a big pot, drain.
Add tomato paste, chili powder and cumin, stir for 1 minute.
Add tomatoes and 1 cup water. Simmer 35 to 40 minutes.
Add beans to the family portion at the end. Serve with cheese.

name: Breakfast for Dinner
description: Scrambled eggs, bacon, and pancakes for those who want them.
keto_swap: Keto: eggs, bacon, sausage and avocado. Family: pancakes and fruit.
steps: Bake bacon on a sheet pan at 400F for 15 to 20 minutes.
Cook sausage in a skillet.
Scramble eggs low and slow in butter.
Make pancakes for the family while the rest finishes.

name: Crispy Baked Chicken Tenders
description: Crunchy oven-baked tenders without the fryer.
keto_swap: Keto: coat in almond flour and parmesan. Family: panko breadcrumbs. Same method, two trays.
steps: Heat oven to 425F with a rack on a sheet pan.
Dip tenders in beaten egg, then coat: almond flour and parmesan for keto, panko for the family.
Bake 18 to 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and 165F inside.
Roast green beans on the side. Serve with ranch.

name: Slow Cooker Chicken Tacos
description: Dump chicken, salsa and spices in the cooker and shred. Very low effort.
keto_swap: Keto: serve over lettuce with cheese, sour cream and avocado. Family: tortillas.
steps: Put chicken, salsa and taco seasoning in the slow cooker.
Cook on low 6 to 8 hours or high 3 to 4 hours.
Shred with two forks and stir back into the juices.
Serve with toppings.
